objective: Gate 5C preflight. Confirmar contrato exacto de Servidores_ConexionEstado para persistencia de health y mapear jobs existentes de Sync_Control_Ejecuciones al Codigo exacto de Sistema_Sync_Catalogo. Solo lectura. No secretos. No DDL/DML. Production prohibida.

queries.name: gate5c_health_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name column_name,t.name data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,dc.definition default_definition FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Servidores_ConexionEstado') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: gate5c_health_keys
queries.sql: SELECT kc.name constraint_name,kc.type_desc,c.name column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.key_constraints kc JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=kc.parent_object_id AND ic.index_id=kc.unique_index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE kc.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Servidores_ConexionEstado') ORDER BY kc.name,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: gate5c_sync_catalog
queries.sql: SELECT Codigo,Nombre,Grupo,Handler,HandlerImplementado,RequiereUnidad,Activo FROM dbo.Sistema_Sync_Catalogo ORDER BY Orden,Codigo

queries.name: gate5c_existing_sync_types
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 SyncType,COUNT_BIG(*) total FROM dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones GROUP BY SyncType ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(*) DESC,SyncType

queries.name: gate5c_connection_unit_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 CONVERT(varchar(36),id) ConexionID,nombre,system_type,tipo_conexion,EmpresaID,sucursales,activo FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones ORDER BY tipo_conexion,nombre

queries.name: gate5c_units
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),id) UnidadNegocioID,codigo,nombre,activo FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio ORDER BY nombre
